block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Master error code taxonomy registering all Engine (0x0xxx) and Game (0x1xxx) error classifications.
what_it_enables: Deterministic, unambiguous separation of Engine vs. Game runtime failures
Hierarchical categorization: Domain -> Category -> Subcategory -> Error Code
Actionable root-cause hints, suggested remedies, and grep-able breadcrumbs
invariants: Engine errors strictly confined to hex range [0x0001, 0x0FFF]
Game errors strictly confined to hex range [0x1000, 0x1FFF]
Universal 5-Block Lifecycle Protocol enforced across all definitions

domains.title: Engine Infrastructure & Platform Domain
domains.description: Failures originating in Layer 0 Core Utilities or Layer 2 Presentation Viewports.

errors.description: Division by zero intercepted in arithmetic routine.
errors.root_cause_hints: safe_div() invoked with denominator == 0.
errors.suggested_remedy: Ensure stats or factors have non-zero floor or pass explicit fallback.

errors.description: Value breached configured mathematical bounds and was clamped.
errors.root_cause_hints: clamp_i32() or clamp_f32() saturated an out-of-range value.
errors.suggested_remedy: Check input calculation scaling before clamping.

errors.description: Integer arithmetic overflow averted by saturating arithmetic.
errors.root_cause_hints: Multiplication or addition exceeded INT32_MAX.
errors.suggested_remedy: Use saturating math routines from math_utils.h.

errors.description: Monotonic clock regression detected (current timestamp < previous).
errors.root_cause_hints: Operating system clock desync or timer virtualization reset.
errors.suggested_remedy: Audit CLOCK_MONOTONIC implementation on host platform.

errors.description: Frame delta exceeded 100 ms max clamp ceiling.
errors.root_cause_hints: Heavy garbage collection, I/O stall, or window dragging.
errors.suggested_remedy: Simulation clamped to 100 ms to prevent physics spiral of death.

errors.description: String destination buffer truncated during bounded copy.
errors.root_cause_hints: Source string length exceeds destination buffer capacity.
errors.suggested_remedy: Increase destination buffer size or shorten narrative string.

errors.description: NULL pointer passed to string utility function.
errors.root_cause_hints: Uninitialized char pointer passed into str_safe_copy().
errors.suggested_remedy: Validate string pointer pre-conditions before invocation.

errors.description: Dynamic heap allocation attempted in Layer 0/1 (malloc/calloc).
errors.root_cause_hints: Violation of Axiomatic Invariant #1 (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP).
errors.suggested_remedy: Use static BSS buffers or stack-allocated structures only.

errors.description: Static telemetry ring buffer capacity reached; oldest entry overwritten.
errors.root_cause_hints: High-frequency logging outpaced file flushing.
errors.suggested_remedy: Increase file flush cadence or raise min_severity filter.

errors.description: Function call stack depth exceeded 64 KB safety headroom.
errors.root_cause_hints: Deep recursive call chain in DAG registry or pathfinding.
errors.suggested_remedy: Refactor recursive routines to iterative state machines.

errors.description: Target data asset path could not be resolved across candidate roots.
errors.root_cause_hints: File missing, misspelled path, or incorrect legacy alias.
errors.suggested_remedy: Verify file existence in game/data/ and check fs_utils.c candidate list.

errors.description: Bounded file read operation failed or returned zero bytes.
errors.root_cause_hints: File read permission denied, empty file, or I/O lock.
errors.suggested_remedy: Check file permissions and ensure file is non-empty.

errors.description: Maximum rotated log archive count reached; oldest archive pruned.
errors.root_cause_hints: Log directory reached configured max_rotated_files (25).
errors.suggested_remedy: Normal maintenance lifecycle; archives safely rotated.

errors.description: Disk write or directory creation blocked by Floppy Safe-Mode read-only latch.
errors.root_cause_hints: Engine running in Floppy Read-Only Safe Mode or read-only storage.
errors.suggested_remedy: Keep telemetry and saves in static RAM ring/buffers or clear read-only latch.

errors.description: Resolved path exceeded bounded POSIX path buffer ceiling or failed traversal check.
errors.root_cause_hints: Oversized data root, long filename, or disallowed '..' traversal segment.
errors.suggested_remedy: Ensure VFS path and root fit within path_max_bytes without escaping sandbox.

errors.description: File payload exceeded caller bounded buffer or active max_config_bytes ceiling.
errors.root_cause_hints: Config or JSON file grew larger than buffer ladder tier allows.
errors.suggested_remedy: Raise buffer tier in fs_buffers.json or compact oversized manifest.

errors.description: Requested Config ROM stem missing or failed 5-block envelope integrity check.
errors.root_cause_hints: Unknown rom:// URI or stale generated *_rom.h header after CMake change.
errors.suggested_remedy: Rebuild with CMake ROM generator or supply valid rom:// stem.

errors.description: JSON syntax error encountered: unclosed quotes or missing comma.
errors.root_cause_hints: Malformed JSON file on disk.
errors.suggested_remedy: Validate JSON format against standard syntax.

errors.description: Required key not found in specified JSON scope.
errors.root_cause_hints: Key missing from manifest or profile catalog.
errors.suggested_remedy: Supply key in data file or rely on C11 fallback default.

errors.description: JSON structural nesting exceeded bounded zero-heap max_json_depth limit.
errors.root_cause_hints: Deeply nested or malformed JSON input exceeds max_json_depth (32).
errors.suggested_remedy: Flatten JSON nesting or validate structural brackets before parsing.

errors.description: Native X11 display server connection failed; falling back to terminal CLI.
errors.root_cause_hints: DISPLAY environment variable unset or X server not running.
errors.suggested_remedy: Expected behavior in headless CI; engine falls back gracefully.

errors.description: X11 double-buffer backbuffer surface creation failed.
errors.root_cause_hints: X11 server out of memory or window context destroyed.
errors.suggested_remedy: Verify X11 server memory limits or switch to CLI mode.

errors.description: Character glyph missing from Cinzel or MedievalSharp font face.
errors.root_cause_hints: Text contains non-ASCII character outside font glyph coverage.
errors.suggested_remedy: Substitute glyph with '?' or add glyph to font rasterizer.

domains.title: Tactical RPG Simulation & Narrative Domain
domains.description: Failures originating in Layer 1 Simulation Engine (Combat, Hero, Relics, World, Statera).

errors.description: Hero HP, MP, or TP dropped below zero and was clamped.
errors.root_cause_hints: Damage or cost exceeded available vitals pool without check.
errors.suggested_remedy: Verify vital subtraction logic clamps cleanly at 0.

errors.description: Exploration stat score calculated outside canonical [1, 20] scale.
errors.root_cause_hints: Buff or debuff formula applied incorrect multiplier.
errors.suggested_remedy: Saturate stat calculation to clamp strictly in [1, 20].

errors.description: Attempted stance transition rejected by stance state machine.
errors.root_cause_hints: Unit cannot transition directly between requested stance pair.
errors.suggested_remedy: Transition through STANCE_NEUTRAL or verify stance prerequisites.

errors.description: Unit attempted stance transition without sufficient Tactical Points (TP).
errors.root_cause_hints: Current TP < stance transition cost.
errors.suggested_remedy: Check unit TP before command dispatch; notify player via UI.

errors.description: Unit attempted diagonal traversal through an enemy Heavy Zone of Control.
errors.root_cause_hints: Pathfinding algorithm failed to account for heavy ZOC boundaries.
errors.suggested_remedy: Route movement around ZOC or engage the frontline unit directly.

errors.description: Target raw DEF evaluated to zero during damage formula calculation.
errors.root_cause_hints: Target armor shattered or corrupt defense stat.
errors.suggested_remedy: safe_div enforces floor DEF of 1 to prevent zero division.
errors.breadcrumb_pattern: [ERR_GAME_COMBAT_FORMULA_DEF_ZERO] Zero DEF floored to 1 for calculation

categories.title: Twin Relics (Shield of Lux & Sword of Tenebris)

errors.description: Relic resonance power exceeded 100 maximum charge ceiling.
errors.root_cause_hints: Kinetic absorption or edge sharpening added charge past cap.
errors.suggested_remedy: Saturate relic charge strictly at MAX_RESONANCE (100).

errors.description: Moral sway calculated outside [-100, +100] continuum.
errors.root_cause_hints: Unbounded addition to Conscience Ledger moral sway.
errors.suggested_remedy: Clamp moral sway strictly in [-100, +100].

errors.description: Cumulative Virtue or Malice accumulator dropped below zero.
errors.root_cause_hints: Conscience Ledger accumulators are monotonic and must not decrement.
errors.suggested_remedy: Enforce monotonic accumulation: virtue_acc >= 0, malice_acc >= 0.

errors.description: Entity placed or moved outside map grid boundary dimensions.
errors.root_cause_hints: Movement delta pushed coordinates past map width or height.
errors.suggested_remedy: Clamp coordinates within [0, map_width - 1] and [0, map_height - 1].

errors.description: Dialogue speaker tag not found in lexicon.json registry.
errors.root_cause_hints: Typo in speaker tag or unregistered NPC ID.
errors.suggested_remedy: Register speaker tag in lexicon.json or fallback to narrator.

verification_tripwires.name: MNEMONIC_UNIQUENESS
verification_tripwires.rule: every error code has a unique mnemonic string
